Final categorization: EXCLUDED  
(Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that investigates the impact of scale (spatial extent, cell size, neighborhood configuration) on the behavior of a cellular automata (CA) model—specifically CLUE-S—used for land use change modeling. While it involves LULC simulation, its primary objective is not LULC prediction itself but rather methodological sensitivity analysis of scale effects on model behavior (transition rule expression and output precision). The study area includes Beijing Province and Miyun County—both subnational regions—thus failing the core inclusion criterion of "explicit national-scale spatial implementation." Additionally, the study simulates only one observed historical transition period (1991–2004) without implementing or comparing ≥2 future scenarios, violating another core inclusion requirement. Although it uses quantitative metrics (kappa index) and produces spatial outputs, it does not meet all mandatory inclusion criteria and is therefore excluded.)
